visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair featuring light blonde streaks in front sits in a professional red and black gaming chair. She wears a grey long-sleeved dress with a ribbed texture and smiles warmly while holding a white AirPods Pro 3 charging case. The background is a brightly lit studio with white walls and some dark shelving visible behind her. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up comparison shot where two white earbud charging cases are placed side-by-side on a light-colored wooden table. Behind them is a textured red brick wall. White text overlays label the models 'AirPods Pro 2' and 'AirPods Pro 3,' highlighting the physical size difference of the cases. (3) Back in the main studio setting, the woman holds up a single white earbud with a visible black sensor and a white silicone tip. She inserts it into her right ear and performs a rapid head-shaking motion to demonstrate that the device remains securely in place without falling. (4) The visual switches to a digital screen capture sequence showing the iPhone Health app with a pink heart icon and '87 BPM' heart rate data. It then transitions to a translation app interface displaying a text-based dialogue between English and Traditional Chinese speakers with grey and teal speech bubbles. (5) In the final shot, the woman is back in her gaming chair, holding the white charging case near her face. She looks into the lens and uses both hands to point towards the bottom of the screen where variety-show style subtitles are displayed, encouraging audience engagement.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 還在猶豫要不要換 AirPods Pro 3 嗎？ [Variety]: 升級亮點. (2) [Subtitle]: 一次告訴你. (3) [Slogan]: 1. 造型改變. (4) [Logo]: AirPods Pro 2. [Logo]: AirPods Pro 3. [Subtitle]: 耳機本人和充電盒有了不同的造型設計. (5) [Subtitle]: 耳機更符合人體工學 不過盒子更大. [Slogan]: 2. 材質配戴. (6) [Subtitle]: 耳塞換成海綿材質 配戴起來更貼耳舒服 也更不容易掉. [Slogan]: 3. 降噪音質. (7) [Subtitle]: 這代降噪效果很明顯的提升 光是戴上就幾乎聽不到聲音. (8) [Subtitle]: 不過音質和 AirPods Pro 2 相比 其實沒有差很多. [Slogan]: 4. 續航電量. (9) [Logo]: 8 小時. [Logo]: 5 小時. [Logo]: 24 小時. [Logo]: 30 小時. [Subtitle]: 從 5 小時進步到 8 小時 但搭配充電盒的時數 從 30 變成 24 小時. (10) [Subtitle]: 就實際使用下來的續航來說 也大概兩天需要充一次. [Slogan]: 5. 全新功能. (11) [Subtitle]: 這次也支援了兩個新功能. [Variety]: 心率偵測. (12) [Subtitle]: 現在只要戴著耳機 就可以看到自己的心率. (13) [Subtitle]: 而即時翻譯 實測過後準確度也確實很高 只需一方配戴耳機就能使用. (14) [Subtitle]: 真的很方便耶 目前臺灣售價是 NT$7,490 元. (15) [Subtitle]: 你有心動嗎 底下留言你的看法吧.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with short black hair and blonde highlights. She is wearing a grey long-sleeved dress and sitting in a gaming chair.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track opens with a female voice with high emotional arousal and positive valence, speaking over an upbeat electronic BGM with a steady kick drum and synth chords. (2) A distinct mechanical 'click' sound occurs as she opens the plastic charging case. (3) She continues her narrative with high articulation clarity. A digital 'whoosh' sound effect provides a smooth transition to the next scene. (4) A bright, high-frequency notification 'ping' sound marks the introduction of the first design comparison point. (5) Another digital 'whoosh' transition sound effect is used to shift focus to the earbuds' material. (6) A sharp 'ding' sound effect alerts the listener to a change in topic regarding noise cancellation. (7) An electronic 'riser' sound effect creates a sense of buildup before she discusses software features. (8) The female voice asks a question with rising intonation as a final synthesized stinger sound effect concludes the audio track.
